basic_details.short_information: Shri Narang Sanskrit Snatakottar Mahavidyalaya (Shri Narang Sanskrit Postgraduate College), Ghughli, Maharajganj, Uttar Pradesh, has 6 unreserved teaching posts: two Heads of Department and two Assistant Heads of Department in Sahitya and Vyakaran, one Assistant Head of Department (Adhunik, Hindi) and one Teacher (Adhunik, Hindi). Applications must reach the Manager/Secretary of the college at Post-Ghughli, District Maharajganj, PIN Code-273151 by registered post within 21 days of the advertisement's publication. content_sections.heading: About Shri Narang Sanskrit PG College Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The six posts fell vacant on the retirement of the earlier teachers. The District Inspector of Schools, Maharajganj, confirmed the 6 vacancies in a letter dated 27 October 2026. Applications are invited under the reservation rules of the Uttar Pradesh Government and the university's ordinances on appointments.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application by registered post to this address: Manager/Secretary, Shri Narang Sanskrit Snatakottar Mahavidyalaya, Post-Ghughli, District Maharajganj, PIN Code-273151, Uttar Pradesh Pay the fee by bank draft only. The notice does not mention refunds.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Sahitya means Sanskrit literature, Vyakaran means grammar and Adhunik means modern subjects, as used in Sanskrit colleges. The notice names the posts in Hindi. The English names below are given with the printed names in brackets. All six posts are unreserved. None of the posts is reserved for SC, ST or Backward Class candidates. Head of Department (Sahitya), Assistant Head of Department (Sahitya), Head of Department (Vyakaran) and Assistant Head of Department (Vyakaran): Postgraduate degree in the relevant subject, second division. Preference is given to a traditional degree. Assistant Head of Department (Adhunik, Hindi) and Teacher (Adhunik, Hindi): Postgraduate degree in the relevant subject, second division. The age limit is not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the subject-specific eligibility of each post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Shri Narang Sanskrit PG College Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies, one in each post: Head of Department (Sahitya), Assistant Head of Department (Sahitya), Head of Department (Vyakaran), Assistant Head of Department (Vyakaran), Assistant Head of Department (Adhunik, Hindi) and Teacher (Adhunik, Hindi). All 6 are unreserved.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the college within 21 days of publication of the advertisement. The advertisement first appeared on 2 November 2026, which makes the last date about 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: Every post requires a postgraduate degree in the relevant subject, second division. For the four Sahitya and Vyakaran posts, preference is given to a traditional degree.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1000.00 for General / Backward Class and Rs. 500.00 for SC and ST candidates. Pay it by bank draft in favour of "Rakh-Rakhav Shri Narang Sanskrit P.G. College Ghughli Maharajganj U.P.".

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send your application by registered post to the Manager/Secretary, Shri Narang Sanskrit Snatakottar Mahavidyalaya, Post-Ghughli, District Maharajganj, PIN Code-273151, Uttar Pradesh. Enclose your self-attested documents, the bank draft and a stamped self-addressed envelope.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay scale?
faq.answer: Both Heads of Department get the 4800 pay scale (47600 to 151100). The three Assistant Heads of Department get the 4600 pay scale (44900 to 142400). The Teacher (Adhunik, Hindi) gets the 4200 pay scale (35400 to 112400).

faq.question: Q7. What should I write on the envelope?
faq.answer: Write the name of the post you are applying for on the envelope in bold letters.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents must be attached?
faq.answer: Attach the following: Self-attested photocopies of all educational records and qualifications The caste certificate The Aadhaar card The fee bank draft A self-addressed envelope with a registered-post stamp

faq.question: Q9. Will late applications be accepted?
faq.answer: No. Applications received after the prescribed time, and defective applications, will be rejected.
